Internal: a sheet's variables of numbers made text by a few cells

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_marker_columns.Rd

The Excel side of ruling R31's question 5: each text variable not named in text =, its footnote rows left out of the first variable. A variable is named only when NUMBER cells are more than half of its cells that are not empty, and at least one text cell holds a value that is not a number (ICD codes typed as text, 250.10 beside 250.1, are text cells throughout, and are never named). readxl gives a variable holding a text cell as text, so a number stored as text beside the number cells keeps it text whatever na = names; since Session 381 (Fix Slate 24, the (S380) item) such a variable is named too, with stored counting those cells, and the note gives it the lines that make it numbers in R rather than a reload (until then it was passed over, and the scan's declaration left it text). A stored number whose value numbers would change – a leading zero, more than 15 digits (ruling R31, questions 1 and 2) – still passes the variable over. Only the cells say which (as .jst_excel_cells_numeric() does for footnotes, Session 365), read again for the variables in question.

Usage

.jst_marker_columns(df, skip_pos = integer(0), cells = NULL, header = TRUE)

Arguments

df

The sheet as read.

skip_pos

Positions not to look at (text =).

cells

A function of positions giving those variables read as cells (readxl's col_types = "list"), or NULL for no such check.

header

jload()'s header: read with FALSE, a variable whose first cell is a word is passed over, since that row may be the names.

Value

A list of list(pos, values, counts), each with stored, the count of numbers stored as text, when cells is given.
